codeReview.summary: The implementation adds comprehensive unit tests for coordinate transformations between logical and physical pixels in the UI rendering system. All 12 new tests pass, covering VAL-POS-001 (Element Positioning Accuracy), VAL-POS-003 (Coordinate Transformation Correctness), and FLOW-001 (HiDPI Text Rendering Pipeline). The tests are well-structured, thorough, and follow the existing test patterns in the codebase.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker consistently uses test naming pattern `test_<feature>_<aspect>` which matches project convention. Tests are organized into logical sections with comment headers marking which validation assertion they verify (e.g., 'VAL-POS-001: Element Positioning Accuracy Tests').
sharedStateObservations.evidence: katla_app/src/ui/renderer.rs:243-486 - Tests organized with section headers and descriptive names like test_vertex_positions_match_requested_bounds, test_logical_to_physical_coordinate_conversion

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker follows the pattern of using `use katla_math::{Color, Rect2D, Vec2}` imports inside test functions rather than at module level, which keeps imports localized to where they're needed.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: katla_app/src/ui/renderer.rs:247, 275, 314 - Each test function imports types it needs locally

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker ran `cargo test -p katla_app --lib ui::renderer::tests` to test specific module, then ran `cargo test -p katla_app -p katla_gfx -p katla_ui --lib` for broader validation. These commands match the test commands specified in .factory/services.yaml.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff verification.commandsRun shows: `cargo test -p katla_app --lib ui::renderer::tests` and `cargo test -p katla_app -p katla_gfx -p katla_ui --lib`

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker demonstrated understanding of the coordinate system architecture: vertex positions stored in logical pixels in VertexUI, scale_factor field added to UIDrawList for shader-based transformation to physical pixels, clip_rect remains in logical pixels with scaling happening in execute_ui_draw_list. This architectural knowledge should be documented in .factory/library/ for future workers.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Test comments in katla_app/src/ui/renderer.rs:328-338 explain: 'Logical positions should STILL be the same in VertexUI. The scaling to physical happens in the shader: physical = logical * scale_factor'

summary: Feature add-coordinate-transform-tests successfully adds 12 comprehensive unit tests for coordinate transformations. All tests pass, validators pass (test, clippy, fmt). Tests cover logical/physical pixel conversion, scale factor handling, vertex position preservation, color/UV preservation, clip rect scaling, spatial relationship preservation, and screen size coordinate system. No blocking or non-blocking issues found. Worker followed established conventions and test patterns. Consider adding coordinate transformation architecture to .factory/library/architecture.md for future reference.
